events.title: East Suffolk Wireless Revival
events.description: The East Suffolk Wireless Revival — a local radio rally for amateur radio operators and enthusiasts. Traders, bring-and-buy, and a great chance to meet local operators.

events.title: 145 Alive — Mill Farm Radio Group
events.description: 145 Alive UK activity day. The Mill Farm Radio Group (MX0MFR) will be active on 145.525 MHz FM from Stowmarket (JO02mg) — 1200–1500 BST. Net controller 2E0DIQ. Part of the national 145 Alive initiative encouraging activity on 2m FM.
